locators.title: Major rivers and urban centers in the Pilbara–Gascoyne region
Rivers and catchments in the Pilbara–Gascoyne region

own_factual_extraction: The maps distinguish the Murchison and Gascoyne courses from the Wooramel and Lyons rivers. Hope is separately labeled near Lake Annean.
Section 11.5.1 places Murchison headwaters in the Robinson Range and separately names Hope, Roderick and Sandford as joining rivers.
The maps cover the selected western-coast river corridors and adjoining inland drainage; basin labels are distinguished from labels following river lines.
limits: The regional raster is low resolution and has no usable coordinate grid for an exact reach-name crosswalk.
Two figures from the same report are not independent publications.
Named neighboring and joining rivers cannot inherit one representative system label.
